bootstrap_result.checks_interpretation: Successful checked path of the reviewed bootstrap, not an independent rerun of privileged commands.

external_tcp_probe.interpretation: 6379 was unreachable from this client/network at the time of the check; does not prove universal isolation.

initial_failure.detail: internal Docker network did not publish the port; healthy/authentication inside container passed before the bootstrap stopped at old line 52.
initial_failure.resolution: Narrow resume-network path preserved empty volume and credentials, switched to dedicated bridge with explicit loopback publication, then completed checks.

time_sources.note: Server and client clocks differ; timestamps retain their source and are not used to infer elapsed durations.

limitations: API/Worker are not deployed or integrated with Redis.
No backup/restore, crash recovery, load/OOM, memory calibration or alerting acceptance.
AOF everysec and a local named volume do not protect against losing the VPS.
Application cache reconnection after its finite retry budget remains to be verified/resolved.
Bootstrap status text retains external-port-pending because the external probe was performed outside the root script.
